Left insole, March build. Kept for the record.

- FSR 402 under the heel, three FSR 400s under the forefoot
- 100 Hz over Bluetooth, 12-bit
- Calibration drifts about 4% an hour; see [[Sensor sampling rates]]

Replaced by the 1.3 board.
